capabilities: highlight ```pml fenced code blocks in Reading mode and Live Preview
open raw .pml, .pmlobj, .pmlfnc, .pmlfrm, .pmlmac and .pmlcmd files in an editable highlighted view
fold PML control blocks like if/endif, do/enddo and define/end definitions
toggle highlighting modes and override token colors per category in settings
extras: README states it is an independent personal project not affiliated with or endorsed by AVEVA; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; bugs are handled via GitHub issues.
problem: Obsidian has no syntax highlighting for AVEVA's PML language, so PML code blocks and .pml-family files render as plain uncolored text.
summary: Syntax highlighting plugin that colors AVEVA PML/PML2 code in ```pml fenced blocks and raw .pml-family files, with code folding.
